title: Historical VaR and ES at two levels, method pinned
source:
import json, os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
ret = pd.read_csv("/input/environment/data/returns.csv")["ret"].to_numpy(float)
out = {}
for a in (0.95, 0.99):
    q = np.quantile(ret, 1 - a, method="linear")
    tag = str(int(round(a * 100)))
    out[f"var_{tag}"] = float(-q)
    out[f"es_{tag}"] = float(-ret[ret <= q].mean())
os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
json.dump(out, open("/app/output/risk.json", "w"), indent=2)
